title: Zoning map change for 862-868 Kent Avenue, Brooklyn
summary: This resolution approves a City Planning Commission decision to rezone property at 862-868 Kent Avenue and 123-125 Taaffe Place in Bedford-Stuyvesant, Brooklyn from M1-1 to M1-4/R6A and establish a Special Mixed Use District. The change would allow construction of two residential buildings with 74 total units, including 19 permanently income-restricted units.
